name: Buchanan County, MO
findings: Buchanan County has 348 nonprofit organizations. 135 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 114 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Buchanan County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
